title: Proposed closed A2 record structures; semantic predicate is mandatory
x-canonical-parse-predicate: Before decoding: UTF-8 ASCII JSON only; per-record byte length <=16777216 and cumulative evidence <=16777216, with tighter input_bundle<=262144 and failure_index<=524288 bounds. Depth <=16, nodes <=32768 per record, strings <=256 ASCII bytes except raw_hex <=8192 and rational fields <=8193/8192; IDs <=64; bounded decoder must count before allocation. No comments/BOM/trailing data. raw_request_utf8_hex is a bounded escape exception (<=524288 hex characters), but the WHOLE serialized input bundle must still fit 262144 bytes including that copy; do not duplicate raw bytes unnecessarily.

Reject duplicate object keys using object_pairs_hook or equivalent; reject NaN/Infinity/-Infinity via parse_constant; every JSON numeric token must use integer lexical form (no decimal point/exponent). For integer fields require type(value) is int, not bool/float; for boolean fields require type(value) is bool. In particular JSON 1.0 and true are not integer 1, and 0/1 are not booleans. Schema integer checks alone are insufficient.

Only declared keys allowed, ALL keys required, no implicit default. Exact enums require type as well as value: certification flags are genuine false bool, not 0. Preserve malformed request bytes for negative fixtures rather than coercing them.

Rationals use lowercase hex, no 0x/plus/leading zeros/-0; den>0; gcd(abs(num),den)==1; zero ONLY num=0,den=1. Validate lengths BEFORE int conversion, normalized bits <=32768; request tau <=256 bits each, tau>=0. Negative/noncanonical tau is invalid_request; oversized canonical tau is unsupported_reference.

Raw arrays: nbytes == len(raw_hex)//2 == product(shape)*itemsize (float32=4, float64=8, complex64=8, complex128=16; complex input is structurally decodable but unsupported by this reference), scalar [] has one item; rank/shape validated before allocation, C order, explicit byte order, SHA256 over decoded raw bytes. Finite check follows artifact authentication. Signed zero bytes remain identity data. Exact arrays have product(shape) values, each canonical rational. N by N analytic matrix may have 289 values.

Evidence IDs unique per case+record kind; candidate IDs need not be unique in bounded INVALID raw input. Candidate occurrences retain supplied-order candidate_index including duplicate IDs, no coercion. Exact post-mutation slot/comparison/binding inventory required. Typed disposition table and schema-control-contract.md are mandatory: known-ineligible slots not_applicable with actual ineligibility reasons, never not_evaluated; unknown/not_evaluated null payloads/binding; complete exactly one payload/binding; partial proper prefix with explicit index remainder. reason equals reasons[0], preserve every observable reason.

Producer binding has the exact closed payload/digest recipe in x-binding-digest-recipe and schema-control-contract.md; enforce launch/run/process/invocation/case/request/input/source/config/mode/branch and actual returned payload descriptor crosslinks. Candidate-free full observations use full_configuration/full_producer and null candidate ID/index, source fractional.py, never fit attribution. Hashes establish consistency, not execution authentication.

Recompute shared exact identities, every fitted kernel/output/residual/B/analytic gradient, qualification, completeness and rank from authenticated bytes; compare all required empirical operands using named policies. Checksums alone and synthetic expected fields are not semantic proof or worker results.

If result status selected, all assessments known, selected ID minimum eligible qualifier; no_supplied requires all known and none qualify. Any unknown or missing required slot makes result indeterminate under EXHAUSTIVE policy. known_ineligible remains completed only for authenticated, fully characterized invalidity; no numerical arrays need be invented. Retain all observable reason codes.

External manifests exclude themselves. Input bundle precedes launch receipt, raw payload descriptors precede producer binding, then slot wrappers and observations, final process, final index, later supervisor export and external run manifest. Never require own digest or own write duration. No binding hashes a wrapper containing its own binding hash.

Apply field-type failure at its ownership boundary: request/global metadata errors invalidate request; authenticated candidate-local errors are known-ineligible. Structurally valid out-of-tiny-domain values are unsupported_reference, not malformed. Parsed request may be null when raw input cannot form a canonical request record; bounded raw request bytes plus explicit ID/slot inventory preserve the error without coercing invalid fields. Request JSON duplicate keys/nonfinite number tokens are global syntax failures; nonfinite IEEE bytes inside authenticated arrays are candidate-local numeric failures.

Working quantity shapes: input/v/D/D_hat/error/B/analytic_input_gradient/output/full_output/input_AD/direction = input shape; w/g/g_hat/residual/signed_fitted_weights = [N]; L_hat = [N,N]; rhos/coefficients/zero_pattern = [P]; epsilon/alpha/dt/h/objective/order_AD/directional_AD/input_FD/order_FD = []. zero_pattern is an exact 0/1 rational vector derived from returned coefficients, not an untyped JSON boolean/float coercion. Full-output comparison has candidate_id=null. Nonselected preinventoried working branches and singleton FD adjacency are explicitly not_applicable, never missing.

Comparison records must exactly bind a_slot_id and reference_slot_id as enumerated in fixtures; singleton FD adjacency is an explicit not_applicable comparison with null operand IDs. It is not a missing row. Exact full D is independent of candidate, hence candidate_id may be null.

Each future actual-fit base/perturbation additionally has a preinventoried fit identity check in fixtures. Input perturbations require same-mode fit raw identity; order perturbations require source/config binding to actual strong perturbed alpha and recomputed dt**(-alpha), not equality to base coefficients. Preserve all check outcomes, including nonselected not_applicable entries.

AD uses a distinct ad-base observation as explicitly inventoried. Retain its actual auxiliary rhos/coefficients/output together with joint input/order cotangents from the same forward composition. Exact base-reference cache reuse is permitted only after authenticated SAME-mode raw input/fit/alpha/dt equality; no cross-mode borrowing. Binding_check records are complete for every predeclared fit identity check, including unknown/not_evaluated/not_applicable outcomes.

Source repo_path is a bounded relative POSIX path, with no empty, dot or dot-dot component, absolute prefix, drive prefix or backslash; resolve only under repository root. Synthetic producer source denotes the preparation-contract specification, not the production fitter or a claimed JAX execution. Actual-fitter producer source is the pinned _soe.py bytes. Every received raw input or candidate error is preserved as bounded raw data, never a coercion of unknown bytes.

failure_index.slots uses compact index_slot references to immutable record_type=slot artifacts routed by x-artifact-routing and accepted by schema root. Preserve true bounded unsupported expected shapes (including [18] and [18,18]); no arithmetic support extension. Complete/partial artifacts retain actual shapes; unavailable/inapplicable have null artifact/completed shape. Prepersist and budget ALL comparison and fit-binding dispositions and candidate occurrences too. Safe fresh-root/no-follow ownership, immutable array versus atomic index replacement, cumulative/live byte accounting, phase timing and acyclic later index-write export are mandatory per schema-control-contract.md. Reservation failure is bounded indeterminate before numerical work, never omission.

All JSON output artifacts must match both root oneOf and x-artifact-routing; raw logs and owned temporary files are explicitly routed exceptions. STATIC/HYPOTHETICAL witness containers are not observed run artifacts. Full timing/ownership/binding relationships and disposition table are mandatory, not waived by false acceptance flags.

x-artifact-routing.tmp/{id}.part: charged owned uncommitted bounded bytes; never a successful final artifact

slot_partial.reasons: non-none unavailable reason; proper prefix only

check_inapplicable.reasons: same causal inapplicability reasons as slots

x-binding-digest-recipe: sha256(json.dumps(entire producer_binding payload,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False).encode(UTF-8)); no newline, no own digest. returned raw descriptors hash raw bytes; exact descriptors hash canonical exact_array only, never slot wrapper. Mandatory crosslinks and acyclic order in schema-control-contract.md.
